svg.title: C02_category_chord
svg.desc: Directed category chord; sectors ordered compound then disease. Ribbon widths count edge records, not clinical strength. Arrow tips identify target sectors. All 25 typed predicate combinations are separate ribbons; the three therapy phases are explicitly listed. Sector arc totals count incoming plus outgoing incidence (twice the edge total overall). Full counts in schema_counts.csv.
